## Implementation Report — round 2

**Status:** READY-FOR-REVIEW

Round-2 revision of #763. The round-1 ensemble verdict was FAIL (Codex FAIL upheld by the reconciler, severity preserved). This round fixes the 3 BLOCKERs + 2 CONCERNs on the same `issue-763` branch in ONE new commit (`4664737365`) on top of the round-1 commit (`7fe87b1f0f`). All round-1 PASSed items (4-H3 marker shape, pod-side sentinel channel, BatchedAnswerSpanCapture + cosine equivalence, both nulls' full-sweep refit, #742 reliability rebuild, GLM bias-on-noise calibration) are preserved.

### (b) Considered but not done
- **Per-fold ridge λ vs GLM `d` selection.** The capacity MATCH is the feature space (shared PCA reduction at the shared nested-CV `d`); each arm keeps its OWN regularizer on its own terms (GLM picks `d` by its binomial inner criterion; ridge picks `λ` by its PRESS criterion). Forcing ridge to also re-select `d` by a ridge criterion would UN-match the feature space and reintroduce the asymmetry — rejected. The optimism delta is now a same-features comparison, which is exactly what the headline needs.
- **Acceptable fact-pool remedy (cap at distinct count + honest floor-fail).** The brief blessed this as the weaker option; I took the preferred scale-to-≥50 remedy instead so all 5 behaviors keep m≥50 dynamic range. The honest-floor machinery still exists as a backstop (the de-duped pool truncates to its size and reports `yield_shortfall` if a future battery under-fills — no silent backfill).
- **CLAUDE.md gotchas cited.** vLLM teardown / EngineCore-orphan (gotchas.md): the PV `generate` phase `del llm`s the engine before the (separate-process) `capture` phase; `VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn` is set at module top (#628), `use_tqdm=False` on every generate (#613), internal chunking at `EPM_VLLM_GREEDY_CHUNK_SIZE` with per-chunk INFO logs (#664). earlyoom stream-reduce (gotchas.md): the capture phase accumulates per-(arm×layer) sums, never materializing all rollouts. The 3-phase subprocess split (dispatcher runs each `--phase` as a separate `uv run` process) IS the framework-switch isolation the vLLM-teardown gotcha prescribes. `parse_judge_json` keeps a JSON OBJECT and treats a bare integer as parse_error → the PV rubric is wrapped with a thin `{"trait_score": N}` JSON directive (transport format only; REFUSAL preserved); the #658 E0 rubrics already return JSON objects so they need no wrap.
- **HF Hub bulk-upload trap.** Unchanged from round 1 — `issue763_upload.py` uses the bulk `upload_raw_completions_to_data_repo` + `upload_folder` (one commit per dir), never a per-file `upload_file` loop (#664).
